# Code Anchors: Epic Issue Filing

- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts` — the orchestrator: refusals before the first remote call, create-or-promote, the immediate link write-back, then best-effort decoration and the settings write-back.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/preflight.ts` — the pre-write legality decision: containment, prerequisites, the missing title, promotion legality, and the empty-body refusal.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/preflight.spec.ts` — coverage for every refusal this preflight decides before any remote call.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/args.ts` — the epic filer's own frozen argument surface: attached values, prefix abbreviations, ambiguous-prefix refusal, and end-of-options.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/document.ts` — the draft reader and the three body transforms: pointer/queue-path removal, user-stories-section removal, and the meta block.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/document.spec.ts` — coverage for the transforms, including the no-frontmatter and no-stories cases.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/link.ts` — writes the issue number back onto the draft the instant it is known, updating an existing field in place.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/configure.ts` — resolves classification, repo target and the design-warrant label through the shared publishing resolver.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/configure.spec.ts` — coverage for classification-mode selection and the label/type asymmetry.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/design.ts` — applies the needs-design marker from the epic's complexity rollup.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/design.spec.ts` — coverage for the design-warrant threshold.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/environment.ts` — the injected seams: the platform and version-control runners, the confirmation prompt, and the per-stream terminal check.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/output.ts` — the epic filer's own vocabulary: emoji-led, coloured per stream, warnings on stdout.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/platform.ts` — the platform calls unique to filing an epic: reading an issue's current labels and the in-place populate-and-relabel edit.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/projects.ts` — plans project membership for the filed or promoted issue.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/projects.spec.ts` — coverage for the project-planning decision.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/create.spec.ts` — carries the creation-path cases across one for one from the retained runtime's own test module.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/promote.spec.ts` — carries the promotion-path cases across one for one, asserting the two distinct refusals.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/cutover.spec.ts` — the cut-over assertions: no interpreter spawned, no row delegating, name/summary/position unchanged.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/writeback.spec.ts` — coverage for the settings write-back this run triggers on the auto-discovery path.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/fixtures.ts` — shared test fixtures: canned platform responses, a fake environment, and draft builders.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/corpus/*.md`, `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/corpus/golden/*.md` — the committed golden corpus, real and synthetic drafts paired with the retained runtime's recorded output.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/registry.ts` — the registry row this capability now binds directly, in process.
